question: In 2022, Indian-born entrepreneur ____ has been elected as the first representative of the Indian community in Germany
solution:
The correct answer is__** Gurdeep Singh Randhawa**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2022, Gurdeep Singh Randhawa, an Indian-born entrepreneur, made history by being elected as the first representative of the Indian community in Germany.
 
• This election marked a significant milestone as he became the first individual to represent the growing Indian diaspora in Germany, highlighting the increasing prominence of the Indian community in the country.
 
• Randhawa has been active in fostering relationships between India and Germany, and his election reflects both his leadership and the contribution of the Indian community to German society.
 
• His role aims to strengthen cultural, economic, and diplomatic ties between the two nations, advocating for the interests of the Indian community in Germany.
 
• This was a notable event, as the Indian diaspora in Germany has been expanding over the years, contributing to various sectors, including business, science, and technology.
 
• Randhawa's election also represents a broader recognition of the Indian community's role in Germany.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**T.S. Tirumurti**: T.S. Tirumurti is an Indian diplomat and the former Permanent Representative of India to the United Nations (UN). While he has played a significant role in diplomacy, he was not elected as the first representative of the Indian community in Germany.

 
 
• 
 
**Ruchira Kamboj**: Ruchira Kamboj is a senior Indian diplomat who has served as India’s Ambassador to Bhutan and has had various other important diplomatic roles. However, she was not elected as the first representative of the Indian community in Germany in 2022.
